items.item_text: Industry Certifications & Education – Possess at least two of the following:

As a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in network cabling, the candidate should demonstrate advanced knowledge in Ethernet and fiber optic cable termination, testing, and certification. Proficiency in the design, installation, and support of overhead paging systems—both analog and IP-based—is a plus.
CNet Certified Network Cable Installer (CNCI)
Panduit PCI Certification
Microsoft Windows Certification Or equivalent level industry certification
Required to hold a valid California driver's license, have a driving record that is in accordance with local policies/procedures, and/or enroll in the California Employer Pull Notice Program
The ideal candidate should possess strong skills in creating and maintaining technical documentation such as ICRA permits, fiber panel layouts, and network schematics.
College Degree and/or equivalent horizontal cabling certifications or equivalent relevant experience
Bachelor's degree in related field and/or equivalent experience and or training
2 Years working in IT healthcare
Experience designing, engineering, installing, maintaining, and troubleshooting network technologies including structured cabling, pathways and spaces, DAS, overhead paging, optical circuits.
Minimum 3 years of professional experience in telecommunications infrastructure, including hands-on work with structured cabling systems, paging systems, and network hardware.
Experience programming and maintaining 800 MHz handheld radios

Demonstrated 3 years of experience working in active telecom room environments and performing work in compliance with industry standards such as ANSI/TIA, BICSI, and safety regulations. Experience in healthcare or similarly regulated environments is a plus.

The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in telecommunications infrastructure, with hands-on experience installing, maintaining, and troubleshooting fiber optic, coaxial, and copper cabling systems.
Minimum 2 years of experience installing, or maintaining analog and IP-based overhead paging systems.
Experience with wireless communication technologies, including Wi-Fi and Distributed Antenna Systems (DAS), and their integration into enterprise telecom environments is highly desirable.
Minimum 2 years of experience supporting wireless technologies (Wi-Fi, DAS) and integrating them into telecom networks.
The candidate should also have experience in telecom room layout and maintenance, ensuring compliance with standards for airflow, safety, and accessibility.
Minimum 2 years experience installing, maintaining and troubleshooting optical circuits

The Infrastructure Cabling Services (ICS) Communications and Technical Analyst III provides operational and technical support for UC Davis Health’s telecommunications infrastructure and low-voltage systems. Working within a multidisciplinary team that includes Registered Communications Distribution Designers (RCDDs), DAS engineers, and operational technicians, the incumbent collaborates with engineering, construction, and operational stakeholders to ensure telecommunications infrastructure supports the reliability, redundancy, scalability, maintainability, and code compliance required within mission-critical healthcare environments. The Analyst III will engage in all aspects of UCDH cable plant operations, including drafting detailed Statements of Work (SoWs), configuring Power Distribution Units (PDUs) and IP cameras, and maintaining cable plant and design documentation, OHP Overhead paging and creation of Infection Control Risk Assessment (ICRA) permits, preparing fiber panel engineering drawings, and allocating and installing fiber optic circuit IDs. Additional responsibilities include installing and maintaining network and voice cabling, as well as designing, troubleshooting, and servicing both analog and IP overhead paging systems. Successful candidate will perform Level 1 and Level 2 network testing, and be part of an on-call rotation, handling system failures, environmental alerts, and providing 24/7 service support.
50% - Infrastructure Cabling Engineering & Operations
The ideal candidate will possess strong technical expertise, exceptional attention to detail, and solid leadership qualities, with the ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
30% - Communications Infrastructure Planning
20% - Communications & Resources
BICSI Installer 1 or 2 Copper/Fiber
Registered Communications Distribution Designer (RCDD)
The role also demands strong teamwork capabilities to collaborate on multiple concurrent initiatives, ensuring timely completion and regulatory compliance.
Outside Plant Designer (OSP)
Cisco Networking Basics or approved equal
CompTIA (e.g., A+, Network+, Security+)
A solid understanding of both IP and analog communication platforms, including VoIP and legacy phone systems, is preferred.
Technical expertise including configuration and deployment of networking and telecom hardware such as routers, switches, PDUs, and IP surveillance systems is desired.
Familiarity with Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM) and Network Management (Orion) systems, including environmental and power monitoring tools, is preferred.
Strong Understanding of OSI model.

A solid understanding of physical security protocols for data centers and telecom rooms is essential, along with in-depth knowledge of industry standards including ANSI/TIA-568, IEEE, BICSI, and applicable building codes.

The candidate should be well-versed in environmental, electrical, fire, and safety standards for telecom and data center environments, and have working knowledge of Infection Control Risk Assessment (ICRA) procedures, particularly within healthcare settings.
Strong leadership and team collaboration skills are required, including the ability to coordinate effectively with stakeholders and guide cross-functional teams.
Excellent communication skills are necessary for conveying technical information to diverse audiences, both technical and non-technical.
Lastly, the candidate must demonstrate adaptability in fast-paced environments and be comfortable with rapidly evolving technologies and shifting priorities.
